description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CorsConfig' that sets up global Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) settings for a web application. It creates and configures a CorsFilter bean to allow cross-origin requests from any origin, with specific allowed HTTP methods, headers, and response headers, primarily to support Swagger UI and other clients.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class to set up CORS policy globally across the application.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns a CorsFilter bean with a configured CORS policy allowing specific origins, methods, and headers.
